data.name: Wacky Drivers
data.detailed_description:
Get ready for Wacky Drivers!

Welcome to Wacky Drivers, the ultimate arcade racing experience where speed, skill, and pure madness collide! Jump into the driver’s seat and race through colorful, dynamic environments packed with surprises at every turn. Whether you're burning rubber in a tropical paradise or drifting through a snowstorm under the stars, every race is a test of reflexes, timing, and creativity.

Game Modes

Grand Prix
Go head-to-head against cunning AI opponents across multiple courses. Pick up power-ups and turbo boosts while avoiding the power-downs, to gain an edge — or turn the race upside down! Only the fastest (and wackiest) will claim the trophy.

Arcade Mode
A true test of endurance! Your car’s fuel is constantly running out, and the only way to survive is to collect gas cans scattered throughout the track. Keep your tank full, avoid hazards, and finish the stage before it’s game over.

Time Attack
Think you’re the fastest driver around? Prove it! In Time Attack, it’s just you and the clock. Race for the best times and compare your results online against players worldwide. Every millisecond matters!

Collect and buy new cars

Earn coins, buy and customize new cars, each with its own stats, handling, and unique personality. Find the ride that matches your play style from speed demon, heavy hitter, or all-around racer.  Pick your car and show off your collection as you conquer new stages and cups.

Explore 16 Unique Stages

Different hand-crafted stages: from sunny beaches and rainy jungles to icy tundras and neon-lit night tracks, every stage offers its own challenges and atmosphere. Master every curve, and discover hidden secrets along the way.

Features

  • Fast, fun, and chaotic arcade racing action

  • 16 hand-crafted stages across diverse environments

  • Multiple game modes for all types of racers

  • Unlockable customizable cars with distinct stats and driving styles

  • Global leaderboards and replay value galore

  • Multiplayer mode! Play with your friends in different cups.

About the Developer

Wacky Drivers is made by a solo developer who grew up playing retro racing games, Wacky Drivers is built from nostalgia and passion, a celebration of the arcade era, where fun came first, and every race was an adventure.

Every part of the game, from the chaotic gameplay to the quirky environments, was built with that same sense of nostalgia and creativity that fueled those unforgettable racing experiences.

Wacky Drivers isn’t just a game — it’s a dream project brought to life, made with heart for players who love the thrill of arcade racing as much as I do.

Get ready to drift, boost, and laugh your way to victory.

In Wacky Drivers, every race is unpredictable — and that’s what makes it so much fun.

data.short_description: A chaotic top-down racer where drifting, boosting, and power-ups turn every race into pure madness! Compete in Grand Prix, Arcade, and Time Attack modes across 16 wild stages. Collect cars, use power-ups, and master every track in this fast, fun, and unpredictable arcade racer!
data.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, French, German
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3-4130 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / GTX 750 Ti
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 Ti or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 10.15
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Apple GPU (Metal 2)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Metal 2 required 64-bit only Rosetta not required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: MacOS Tahoe 26
  • Processor: Apple M3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 or newer
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended
